description: GHE cause -> EFO/MONDO mapping. A mapping is accepted only on an exact normalised label match to an EFO or MONDO disease id. Unmapped causes keep their candidates so the decision can be reviewed; an unmapped disease must render burden as unavailable, never as zero or a default.

resolver.service: Open Targets Platform GraphQL disease search
resolver.rule: exact normalised label match; EFO_ or MONDO_ ids only
resolver.rejected_alternative: top-hit-wins, which maps 'Cervix uteri cancer' to 'uterine cervix neoplasm' and 'Iron-deficiency anaemia' to an HP phenotype term
